mission: Mission 3DF - PopSign fresh5 scaffold prediction confidence packet

head.subject: observer: CONTINUE - popsign fresh5 scaffold confidence handoff

changed_files.change_summary: Records the M3DF no-training scaffold prediction-confidence/logit packet.
Numbered executor session log for the M3DF confidence packet slice.

artifacts_inspected.role: Existing M3DD scaffold checkpoint loaded read-only for inference/parameter diagnostics
M3DF scaffold inference-only raw logit/probability extraction

retained_artifact_vector_availability.conclusion: Retained M3DD artifacts keep validation/test scalar score fields only. They do not retain raw logits, full per-class probability vectors, or train split predictions, so the bounded inference-only extraction was required.

inference_only_extraction.helper_readout_note: The existing helper returned readout.head_module null because it looks for model.head; this scaffold exposes its final layer as model.classifier. A separate read-only classifier parameter peek is recorded below.

classifier_parameter_readout.interpretation: The classifier bias order is pen > thank_you > who > home > morning, so bias alone does not explain the deterministic morning argmax. Weight norm order also does not match the probability/logit ordering because thank_you has the largest row norm while morning is top-1.

cross_split_diagnosis.conclusion: Train, validation, and test all collapse to top-1 morning:125 and top-2 thank_you:125. The failure is not held-out-specific.

explanation_assessment.strongest_current_explanation: stable near-constant feature/readout input produces a deterministic tiny class-wise logit offset; classifier bias alone is not the cause because morning has the lowest classifier bias.
explanation_assessment.remaining_evidence_gap: No scaffold-specific representation/feature localization has been run for the M3DD checkpoint, so feature collapse remains the next local no-training evidence gap.

added_by_m3df: Train split also collapses to the same top-1/top-2 distribution as validation/test.
Raw logits and full per-class probabilities show the same ordering across train/validation/test.
Classifier bias does not explain the morning argmax.

m3ct_late_fusion_comparison.interpretation: The scaffold repeats the exact M3CT class ordering morning > thank_you > who > pen > home across all splits, with a larger but still low mean probability margin around 0.0208 versus M3CT around 0.0026.

decision.rationale: The M3DD scaffold train split collapses to the same deterministic morning/top2-thank_you ordering as validation/test, raw logits and probabilities repeat the M3CT class ordering, and read-only classifier parameters do not explain the morning argmax. The next smallest useful no-training gap is scaffold-specific representation/feature localization for this checkpoint, not another fit, Brev, export, promotion, downscope, STOP, or strategy escalation.

negative_authorizations_and_proof.proof: Only JSON parsing/audits, py_compile, read-only checkpoint inference extraction, read-only classifier parameter inspection, and tracked receipt/session-log writes were performed. Ignored raw extraction output stayed under output/ and no claim surface changed.

commands_intentionally_not_run: browser activation or model promotion command
